tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who this token is, which workspace it can read, and which scopes it carries. Call this first: it tells you which of the other tools will work.

tools.name: crm_list_leads
tools.description: Leads in this workspace, newest activity first. Phone and email are MASKED here — use crm_get_lead for one record when the full contact is genuinely needed. `total` is the count before paging, so it answers 'how many leads exist'. [scope: crm:read]

tools.name: crm_get_lead
tools.description: One lead in full — unmasked contact details, notes, events, stage history and open tasks. Scoped to this workspace: a lead id from elsewhere reads as not_found. [scope: crm:read]

tools.name: crm_pipeline_overview
tools.description: Every pipeline and stage with its lead count and total value. The shape of the funnel. [scope: crm:read]

tools.name: crm_leads_without_task
tools.description: Open leads with no unfinished task against them — the follow-up leak. Sorted by idle time, longest first. Idle days are counted in Asia/Dubai. [scope: crm:read]

tools.name: ad_attribution
tools.description: Which advertisement produced which conversation: ad id, creative, first-touch flag, and the lead it bound to. The per-click id is NOT returned — only whether one exists. An empty result means no ad-driven conversation has been recorded in the window, not that the tool failed. [scope: marketing:read]

tools.name: agent_conversations
tools.description: Conversations the AI agent handled, with intent, language, message count and the deal they bound to. Contacts masked. [scope: agent:read]

tools.name: agent_get_conversation
tools.description: One conversation with its transcript — what the customer wrote and what the agent answered. [scope: agent:read]

tools.name: dashboard_snapshot
tools.description: The workspace's own KPI contract as the dashboard renders it, with the time it was built. [scope: crm:read]

tools.name: marketing_snapshot
tools.description: Advertising performance: spend, reach, clicks, cost per lead, per campaign, plus the CRM join. [scope: marketing:read]

tools.name: agent_config
tools.description: How the AI agent is set up for this workspace: mode and persona, working hours, hand-over rules, follow-up cadence, trigger list, actions, voice scenarios, and the TITLES of its knowledge documents. Document text is not returned — the list answers what the agent knows about; reading one whole is a s

tools.name: partner_overview
tools.description: This partner's own cabinet: referral code and link, the clients who registered through it, the agreed commission rate, what has accrued so far, and which client workspaces this partner currently holds a grant for. Only answers for a token bound to a partner. [scope: partner:read]

tools.name: voice_calls
tools.description: Calls with direction, disposition and talk time. Customer numbers masked. [scope: crm:read]

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: crm_list_leads, agent_conversations, agent_get_conversation · Private data: whoami, crm_list_leads, crm_get_lead, agent_conversations, agent_config, partner_overview · Public sink: crm_list_leads.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: crm_list_leads, agent_conversations, agent_get_conversation · Private data: whoami, crm_list_leads, crm_get_lead, agent_conversations, agent_config, partner_overview · Public sink: crm_list_leads

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
